name: button-row
label: Row of buttons
description: Two or three buttons side by side; each can be the main (gradient) button or an outline button.
template: {{#each buttons}}{{#link link}}{{#if primary}}{{label}}{{else}}{{label}}{{/if}}{{/link}}{{/each}}

ai.purpose: Several secondary links as buttons in one row.
ai.whenToUse: After body text to point to related pages.
